newsitem.title: USA: People's Choice says delisting hearing set.
newsitem.headline: People's Choice says delisting hearing set.

text.p: People's Choice TV Corp on Wednesday said Nasdaq officials have set June 26 as the date for People's appeal of Nasdaq's previous determination to delist the company's stock.
People's Choice said it is out of compliance with Nasdaq listing criteria because the company has negative tangible net assets as calculated pursuant to Nasdaq's National Market System criteria.
The company on May 15 said it had been told by Nasdaq officials that they would not grant a waiver of the listing criteria.
People's Choice said Nasdaq staff will not recommend People's Choice for listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.
The company will present its case in an oral hearing before a panel appointed by the Nasdaq Board of Governors. The board is expected to render a decision shortly afterward, the company said.
